coverage_notes: Ordinary domestic employment and public-pension income are executable; omitted income classes, loss offsets, and Wave 3 expenditure-, asset-, property-, or transaction-dependent deductions and credits must be supplied as zero.

Medical classification and fact-intensive statutory status decisions are explicit inputs. The model does not infer disability from diagnoses or adjudicate custody, co-residence, support, or agency approval from raw evidence.
No combined disposable-income output is emitted because inhabitant tax and non-uniform health and long-term-care premiums are explicit skips.
Independent oracle comparison and Japanese-language legal review remain release-quality gates, not unencoded Wave 1 policy surfaces.
